channel.title: The Orange County Register - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Orange County Register (ocregister.com)

item.title: Letter: San Clemente’s creepy surveillance cameras
item.description: This should alarm every one of us, regardless of political affiliation — especially small-government and privacy advocates.

item.title: Tech millionaire accused of killing estranged wife from Newport Beach was after money, prosecutors say
item.description: Tech CEO Gordon Goodarzi is accused of murdering philanthropist Aryan Papoli. Her body was found at the bottom of an embankment in Crestline in November.

item.title: Australian Open: Sabalenka’s new mentality vs. Rybakina’s resolve in final
item.description: Aryna Sabalenka is focusing more on past losses to motivate herself for her title match against Elena Rybakina. Sabalenka lost five finals in 2025, including the WTA Finals – to Rybakina. Neither player has dropped a set leading up to this rematch of the 2023 Aussie final.

item.title: Orange County scores and player stats for Thursday, Jan. 29
item.description: Scores and stats from Orange County games on Thursday, Jan. 29

item.title: Kings can’t slow Alex Tuch or solve Alex Lyon in loss to Sabres
item.description: Tuch has his fourth career hat trick and Lyon makes 37 saves as surging Buffalo stops the Kings’ three-game winning streak, 4-1. Adrian Kempe scores for the Kings, who had earned a point in six straight games.

item.title: Santa Margarita girls soccer leans on ‘championship DNA’ to beat Mater Dei
item.description: Four different players score as No. 1 Santa Margarita rallies past No. 2 Mater Dei to regain first place in the Trinity League.

item.title: Kara Dunn reaches milestone as USC women top No. 8 Iowa for statement win
item.description: Dunn scores 25 points and surpasses 1,500 for her career as the Trojans hand the Hawkeyes their first Big Ten loss of the season, 81-69. Jazzy Davidson adds 21 points and eight assists, and Londynn Jones has 17 points.

item.title: Tesoro girls basketball stays in league title chase with win over El Toro
item.description: Tesoro, which has not won a league championship since 2016, holds off El Toro in the final minutes to secure an important win in the Sea View League.

item.title: Canyon girls soccer tops Foothill in showdown for Crestview League title
item.description: Canyon beats Foothill for the second time this season to clinch the league championship.

item.title: Segerstrom boys basketball tops Ocean View to clinch share of league title
item.description: Segerstrom goes nearly four minutes without scoring in the fourth quarter but comes through with a 3-pointer to clinch the victory -- and a share of the league title -- at the end.
